species: Larval SMPs were extracted from C. nippona D-shape larvae (22 hpf) following a modified protocol.
tissue: The remaining shells were immersed in 5% NaOCl for 15 min at 4 °C with gentle shaking, washed with Milli-Q water three times, and then cleaned with a 1-min ultrasound treatment in the Milli-Q water to ensure thorough cleaning
sample_source: Larval SMPs were extracted from C. nippona D-shape larvae (22 hpf) following a modified protocol. Adult shells (including repaired ones) of three C. nippona individuals were treated with 5% NaOCl for 12 h at RT
age: Larval SMPs were extracted from C. nippona D-shape larvae (22 hpf) following a modified protocol. To stimulate shell formation, two-year-old adult oysters were shell-damaged by drilling and cultured as previously described.
